name: visual
description: Explain something from your Codex session in Visual: opens a Visual chat seeded with the session, and answers the Visual agent's follow-up questions from your machine.

interface.shortDescription: Explain your work on a narrated whiteboard
interface.longDescription: Opens a Visual chat about what you're doing in Codex, seeded with your request, a short brief and the session transcript. While the chat is open, the Visual agent can ask this session follow-up questions, which Codex answers read-only from your machine after you approve each answer.
